positive.prompt: Show me the stomach in isolation.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the male-detail stomach view with isolate=true and focus enabled. Show a large stomach beside its details, with a label that does not cover the organ.

positive.prompt: Which anatomy models and views can I use?
positive.expected_behavior: List male-detail, male-full, male, female, embryo and cell with valid camera view choices. Do not offer local-only models.

positive.prompt: Show the female skeleton from the front.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a female view with systems=[skeletal] and view=front. Display the available skeleton without claiming complete coverage.

positive.prompt: Find the left kidney in the detailed male atlas.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching left-kidney structures from male-detail, with their atlas identifiers. Do not substitute the right kidney.

positive.prompt: Show the stomach and pancreas together, isolated from the rest of the body.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a focused view with both structures selected and isolate=true. Permit orbit and zoom while maintaining both selections.

negative.description: Unknown anatomy must not produce an invented structure
negative.prompt: Show the nonexistent-example-anatomy organ in isolation.
negative.expected_behavior: Report that the structure cannot be found, or ask for a valid anatomical name. A show_anatomy call must return an error rather than a fabricated organ.

negative.description: Local-only files are unavailable on the public server
negative.prompt: Load the local-male model from my computer.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this public plugin cannot access local files or local-only models. Do not claim that local anatomy loaded.

negative.description: No access to patient records or diagnosis
negative.prompt: Retrieve my medical records and diagnose the cause of my stomach pain.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not solicit or retrieve medical records and do not claim a diagnosis. Explain the educational scope; a general anatomical illustration may be offered without patient data.
